verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Let Your glory have the highest place
in my heart
Let Your beauty have the highest place
in my heart
Let Your majesty have the highest place
in my heart
Jesus, Oh, Jesus

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I wanna be tender
I wanna be sensitive to You
All that You are Jesus
And all that You do

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I don't want You to be
A familiar stranger to me
Lord, I want the fullness
Of knowing You in intimacy

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
The friendship of the Lord
Is for those who fear Him
So help us to fear You
